```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(hpgR)
```

How many variants should be carried by one, two or more sampled sequences?
Under a neutral, constant-size, infinite-sites coalescent model, the expected
count at derived frequency $i/n$ is $4N_e\mu L/i$.

```{r spectrum, fig.width=6, fig.height=3.5}
n <- 12L
Ne <- 10000
mu <- 1e-8
L <- 10000
prediction <- expectedSFS(n, Ne, mu, L)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(prediction, 4 * Ne * mu * L / seq_len(n - 1L))))
plot(seq_len(n - 1L), prediction, type = "h", lwd = 3,
     xlab = "Derived copies among 12 sampled haploid sequences",
     ylab = "Expected segregating sites")
```

`expectedSFS()` adapts the constant-size recurrence from Daniel Nachun's
demographyTools. The analyzed length includes invariant bases.
